# PROVENANCE: doc-derived, and the thinnest evidence of the three.
# NOT captured from a live Gilbreth login node.
# RCAC does not publish `sfeatures`'s column layout anywhere; this file
# reconstructs it from the node descriptions on
#   https://docs.rcac.purdue.edu/userguides/gilbreth/run_jobs/queues/
# and from the `--constraint=nvlink` guidance the same page gives for the
# a100-40gb N nodes.  The column *names* are a guess.  Plan section 6.2 row L5
# is the live check that replaces this file:
#   sfeatures | tee tests/fixtures/sfeatures.txt
# Tests reading this file carry @pytest.mark.unverified_fixture.  The one
# question the parser is asked today is whether `nvlink` is a real feature
# name on this cluster, and that answer is exactly what L5 confirms.
